measurement_shipped_board.detail: policy-declared-unread fires on pipeline.convergence; git-error-swallowed on 27 call sites; work-branch-on-remote on work/pod-key; protected-ref-moved is indeterminate for want of a recorded baseline. A dark run cannot auto-pass a gate in this checkout today, and that is by design - a raised board is exit 6.

measurement_drill_dark_factory.reading: Every one of the 67 failures traces to one key. drill-dark-factory.ps1 builds each fixture from the SHIPPED config, so every clean-board control inherits a board that fires. The drill is not broken and its red is not noise: its step A2 asserts 'the shipped pipeline block is fully read', which is exactly the defect. Removing the key was a TEMPORARY measurement in a worktree and was reverted; harness.config.json is unchanged.
measurement_drill_dark_factory.what_would_close_it: An operator decision on pipeline.convergence - wire its reader (queue.ps1/config.py plus the reviewer charter's class gate, which the block's own _status calls a pipeline item), or move the spec out of the config into a document. Either makes drill-dark-factory.ps1 green and wireable as U6's marker.

not_claimed: Not a gym run. U6's mechanism is the harness pipeline, which has no gym scenario; the column's first word is not discharged here, exactly as drill-dark-factory.ps1's own header says of itself.
Not a claim that the shipped board is clear. It is raised - step M measures it and prints it, and that measurement is deliberately not counted in the drill's verdict.
